content: {"episode_id":"ep-05041","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for medical necessity, acknowledging that the required prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia, with case diagnosis codes I48.0 and I47.1. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to accurately characterize the frequency and duration of these arrhythmic events for optimal management."}
